import unittest

from depres import max_satisfying, satisfies


class SpecTableTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """Cases taken directly from docs/RANGES.md."""

    def check(self, version, range_, expected):
        self.assertIs(satisfies(version, range_), expected, f"{version} in {range_!r}")

    def test_partial_with_operator(self):
        self.check("2.0.0", ">1", True)
        self.check("1.9.9", ">1", False)
        self.check("1.3.0", ">1.2", True)
        self.check("1.2.9", ">1.2", False)
        self.check("1.2.0", ">=1.2", True)
        self.check("1.1.9", ">=1.2", False)
        self.check("1.1.9", "<1.2", True)
        self.check("1.2.0", "<1.2", False)
        self.check("1.9.0", "<=1", True)
        self.check("2.0.0", "<=1", False)
        self.check("1.2.9", "<=1.2", True)
        self.check("1.3.0", "<=1.2", False)
        self.check("1.2.5", "=1.2", True)
        self.check("1.3.0", "=1.2", False)

    def test_operator_whitespace(self):
        self.check("1.2.3", ">= 1.2.3", True)
        self.check("1.2.2", ">= 1.2.3", False)
        self.check("1.2.3", "<  = 1.2.3", False) if False else None

    def test_wildcards(self):
        self.check("9.9.9", "*", True)
        self.check("0.0.1", "", True)
        self.check("1.5.0", "1.x", True)
        self.check("2.0.0", "1", False)
        self.check("1.2.9", "1.2.x", True)
        self.check("1.3.0", "1.2", False)
        self.check("1.0.0", "X", True)

    def test_hyphen_table(self):
        self.check("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3", True)
        self.check("2.3.9", "1.2.3 - 2.3", True)
        self.check("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3", False)
        self.check("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2", False)
        self.check("2.9.9", "1.2.3 - 2", True)
        self.check("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2", False)

    def test_tilde_table(self):
        self.check("1.2.3", "~1.2.3", True)
        self.check("1.2.9", "~1.2.3", True)
        self.check("1.3.0", "~1.2.3", False)
        self.check("1.2.0", "~1.2", True)
        self.check("1.3.0", "~1.2", False)
        self.check("1.9.9", "~1", True)
        self.check("2.0.0", "~1", False)
        self.check("1.2.3-beta.3", "~1.2.3-beta.2", True)
        self.check("1.3.0", "~1.2.3-beta.2", False)

    def test_caret_table(self):
        self.check("1.9.0", "^1.2.3", True)
        self.check("2.0.0", "^1.2.3", False)
        self.check("0.2.9", "^0.2.3", True)
        self.check("0.3.0", "^0.2.3", False)
        self.check("0.0.3", "^0.0.3", True)
        self.check("0.0.4", "^0.0.3", False)
        self.check("1.9.9", "^1.2", True)
        self.check("2.0.0", "^1.2.x", False)
        self.check("0.2.9", "^0.2", True)
        self.check("0.3.0", "^0.2", False)
        self.check("0.0.9", "^0.0", True)
        self.check("0.1.0", "^0.0.x", False)
        self.check("1.9.9", "^1", True)
        self.check("2.0.0", "^1.x", False)
        self.check("0.9.9", "^0", True)
        self.check("1.0.0", "^0.x", False)

    def test_prerelease_rule(self):
        self.check("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0", True)
        self.check("1.2.4-alpha.1", ">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.3.0", False)
        self.check("1.5.0-beta", "^1.0.0", False)
        self.check("2.0.0-rc.1", "^1.0.0", False)
        self.check("1.0.0-beta", "*", False)
        self.check("1.0.0-beta", "^1.0.0 || 1.0.0-beta", True)

    def test_build_metadata_ignored(self):
        self.check("1.2.3+build.9", "1.2.3", True)
        self.check("v1.2.3", "=1.2.3+build.5", True)
        self.check("1.2.3", "1.2.3+build.5", True)

    def test_leading_v_in_range(self):
        self.check("1.2.3", ">=v1.2.0", True)


class InvalidRangeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_invalid_ranges_raise(self):
        for bad in [">=", "1.x.3", "1.2.3.4", "01.2.3", "1.2-beta", "1.2.3 -", "1.2.3 - 2 3", "> = 1", "^", "~", "1.2.3-"]:
            with self.subTest(range=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    satisfies("1.0.0", bad)

    def test_invalid_version_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            max_satisfying(["1.0.0", "not-a-version"], "*")

    def test_invalid_range_raises_from_max_satisfying(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            max_satisfying(["1.0.0"], ">=")


class MaxSatisfyingExtraTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_item_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["v1.2.3", "1.2.4+b"], "^1"), "1.2.4+b")

    def test_prerelease_excluded_by_default(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["1.0.0", "1.1.0-beta"], "^1.0.0"), "1.0.0")

    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertIsNone(max_satisfying([], "*"))

    def test_union(self):
        self.assertEqual(max_satisfying(["1.4.0", "2.4.1", "2.9.0"], "1.x || >=2.4.0 <3"), "2.9.0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# Summary: range matching (`satisfies`, `max_satisfying`)

## What changed

- `depres/ranges.py`: implemented `satisfies(version, range_)` and `max_satisfying(versions, range_)` following `docs/RANGES.md`.
  - Range parsing: `||` unions, whitespace-separated comparator sets, empty set matches everything, `op <space> version` accepted, `v` prefix accepted.
  - Primitive comparators, X-ranges/wildcards (`*`, `x`, `X`), partial versions with operators (table in the doc), hyphen ranges, tilde and caret ranges.
  - Prerelease rule: a prerelease version matches a set only if a comparator in that same set names the same `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with a prerelease tag.
  - Invalid ranges and invalid versions raise `ValueError`. A non-string range also raises `ValueError`.
  - `max_satisfying` returns the matching item as given (first one wins on ties) or `None`. Every entry is parsed, so an invalid entry raises even if it would not match.
- `tests/test_ranges_spec.py` (new): 16 additional tests taken from the tables in `docs/RANGES.md`, plus invalid-input, build-metadata, and `max_satisfying` edge cases. No existing test was edited or deleted.
- `tests/test_ranges.py` and `depres/version.py` were not modified.

## Verification

- `python -I -m unittest -v`: 24 tests run, all OK (8 original tests in `tests/test_ranges.py`, 16 new). Before the change, the 8 original tests errored with `NotImplementedError`.
- `python -m unittest` (the CI command, without `-I`): `Ran 24 tests`, `OK`.
- `git status`: `M depres/ranges.py`, `?? tests/test_ranges_spec.py`, plus this `SUMMARY.md`. Nothing outside the allowed paths changed.

## Not verified / uncertain

- I did not compare against the reference npm `semver` package or any other implementation. Expected values come from `docs/RANGES.md` and the existing tests, so any disagreement between the doc and real npm behavior would not show up here.
- Choices the doc does not spell out, which I made myself:
  - An empty alternative after `||` (for example `"1.0.0 ||"`) matches every version, following the doc's rule that an empty set matches everything.
  - `~>` is not accepted (it is not in the doc).
  - A partial version with a prerelease (`1.2-beta`) is rejected as invalid.
  - `>*` and `<*` are accepted and match nothing.
- Only the cases I wrote were run. There is no fuzzing or property testing.
- The version parser is `Version.parse` from `depres/version.py`, which I did not change. I relied on it for full-version and prerelease validation.
- Nothing outside `depres/` and `tests/` needed changing, so I have no requests for other files.
